subject.title: Sidebar session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, kept empty, or turned off

question: Should sidebar group management proceed through the linked Control UI-only PR after its pagination blocker is fixed, or should maintainers choose a different sidebar group-management UX/API direction first?
rationale: The issue requests new visible UI controls plus a browser-local grouping preference, carries a protected maintainer label, and already has an open closing PR, so automation should not close it or create a competing implementation.

options.title: Review linked PR after repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the implementation path once its large-group pagination blocker is fixed.

options.title: Redesign first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose a different group-management UX or API boundary before accepting code.

options.title: Decline sidebar group management
options.body: Close this issue and its linked PR only if maintainers decide sidebar groups should remain lightweight and append-only.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR after repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the implementation path once its large-group pagination blocker is fixed.
